title: Integrations
subtitle: Every connector with its honest status and the manual alternative to use meanwhile. Configuration and connectivity checks are done by platform administrators.
honesty: No connector is shown as connected unless a real connectivity check succeeded. While no connector is verified and authorised, nothing is sent outside this hub: notifications stay in-app and files are uploaded or exported by hand.

groups.readHint: These connectors can only bring information in. They hold no permission to send or write, and the hub refuses any send through them.
groups.sendHint: Kept apart from read-only connectors. Even when verified, nothing is sent without an approved sending authority and an approved destination.
groups.futureHint: Described for later phases; no adapter exists and none can be configured in this build.

m365_outlook_mail_send.name: Outlook e-mail (send)
m365_outlook_mail_send.purpose: Would send notification e-mails through Microsoft 365 to approved recipients.

m365_teams_message_send.name: Teams channel messages (send)
m365_teams_message_send.purpose: Would post notifications to an approved Microsoft Teams channel.

m365_teams_meetings_read.name: Teams meetings (read)
m365_teams_meetings_read.purpose: Would read meeting details so minutes can be prepared in the hub.

m365_sharepoint_read.name: SharePoint libraries (read)
m365_sharepoint_read.purpose: Would read documents from selected SharePoint sites as sources.

m365_sharepoint_write.name: SharePoint library (write)
m365_sharepoint_write.purpose: Would file approved exports into one approved SharePoint site.

inbound_webhook.name: Signed inbound webhooks
inbound_webhook.purpose: Receives events from an approved sender: signature, timestamp window and delivery id are checked; a delivery is processed once.

erp_finance.name: ERP / Finance system
erp_finance.purpose: Future: budget and actuals feed for the finance module.

hr_people.name: HR system
hr_people.purpose: Future: people and organisation data for transfers and readiness.

itsm_service_desk.name: ITSM / service desk
itsm_service_desk.purpose: Future: incidents and changes linked to cut-over and transitional services.

dcim_inventory.name: DCIM inventory
dcim_inventory.purpose: Future: data-centre asset inventory for the carve-out perimeter.

vdr_external.name: External virtual data room
vdr_external.purpose: Future: exchange with an external data room for due diligence.

manual.in_app_notifications: people are notified in the hub (bell and inbox); share by your usual channel if needed.
manual.upload_documents: upload the documents in the Documents area; they are kept as sources.
manual.import_wizard: export a file from the source system and bring it in with the import wizard.
manual.export_and_upload: export from the hub and upload the file to the destination yourself.
manual.manual_entry: record the information in the hub by hand.

checkCodes.egress_credentials_in_url: credentials inside an address are refused
checkCodes.egress_port_not_allowed: only the standard https port is allowed
checkCodes.egress_internal_address: internal, private or metadata addresses are refused
checkCodes.egress_host_not_allowlisted: the host is not on the egress allow-list
checkCodes.egress_dns_failed: the host name could not be resolved
checkCodes.egress_timeout: the endpoint did not answer in time
checkCodes.egress_unreachable: the endpoint could not be reached
checkCodes.egress_redirect_refused: the endpoint redirected (redirects are never followed)
checkCodes.egress_http_error: the endpoint answered with an error

admin.hint: Configure a connector with its endpoint and a reference to its secret, then run the connectivity check. Only a successful check marks it Verified; a verified connector still sends nothing without an approved sending authority.
admin.allowlistEmpty: empty — no outbound connection is possible
admin.saved: Configuration saved — not verified until a check succeeds.
admin.configureHint: Saving changes the status to Configured — not verified and disables the connector until a new check succeeds. Secrets are never entered here: give the name of the secret-store entry.
admin.endpointHint: Must be on the egress allow-list. Internal, private, link-local and metadata addresses are refused.
admin.secretRefHint: The name of the secret-store entry (HUB_INTEGRATION_SECRET_<NAME>) — never the secret itself.
admin.testC1: One request is sent to the configured endpoint through the egress guard; the result is recorded in the execution log.
admin.enableC1: The connector becomes available; sending still requires an approved sending authority and destination.
admin.disableC1: Nothing is sent or received through this connector until it is configured and checked again.

refusals.inbound_check: An inbound connector is verified by a signed ping from its sender, not by an outbound check.
refusals.not_verified: Only a verified connector can be enabled or used.
refusals.read_only_connector: A read-only connector cannot send or write.
refusals.send_authority_missing: No approved sending authority exists for this connector.
refusals.documented_only: This integration is documented for a later phase and cannot be configured.
refusals.scope_not_declared: A requested permission is not declared by this connector.
refusals.endpoint_required: This connector needs an endpoint address.
refusals.endpoint_not_applicable: This connector has no outbound endpoint.
refusals.secret_ref_required: A signed inbound connector needs the reference of its signing secret.
refusals.secret_ref_invalid: Give the name of a secret-store entry (HUB_INTEGRATION_SECRET_<NAME>), never the secret itself.
refusals.retry_not_failed: Only a failed delivery can be retried.
refusals.egress: The endpoint was refused by the egress guard: only https on the standard port, on the allow-list, never an internal address.
